svg.text: COMPLEMENTARY FEEDING (6 mo: enriched koko + family foods)

g.text: START 6 mo (not before — gut unready; not late — breast alone insufficient): thick enriched koko
(groundnut paste + milk/egg + palm oil + mashed fruit) → mashed family foods → finger foods →
family pot by 12 mo. Frequency: 2–3 meals (6–8 mo) → 3–4 (9–24 mo) + 1–2 snacks; HYGIENE (M06:
wash, fresh, covered, reheated once); responsive (eye contact, patience, no force).
BREASTFEEDING CRAFT: within 1 HOUR (colostrum = first vaccine!) → attachment (mouth
wide, chin in, lower lip out, more areola below) → 8–12 feeds/day → burp + alternate →
problems solved (sore: latch fix + lanolin/air; engorged: frequent + warm + express; mastitis:
continue + antibiotics + refer if abscess; "not enough": MORE suckling + rest + fluids — 99%
supply meets demand!). HIV: ART + counsel per current guideline (exclusive + adherent).
SCHOOL-AGE (5–9): breakfast daily (learners fed learn!) + lunchbox/pack (protein + fruit +
water) + deworm + vision/hearing + limit sweets/sodas (teeth + weight). TEENS: growth spurt
needs (protein + iron — girls menstruating! + calcium) + sport fuel + body-image care (eating
disorders screened kindly) + junk-talk (shito + kelewele joy + balance, not bans).
ELDERS (GER M06!): protein each meal + calcium/D + fibre + fluids + teeth + company + MUST
screened — appetite + access + ability reviewed every contact.
FAILURE-TO-THRIVE (flat/falling curve — M02!): feed assessed (recall + observe a feed!) +
illness hunted (diarrhoea? TB? HIV? UTI? worms? malaria?) + home visited (who feeds? how
often? beliefs?) + plan (fortify + treat + demo feeds + 2-week review). Admit SAM (M05).
Document IYCF counsel + demos + weights (PRO-I M5); grandmothers + fathers included —
feeding decisions are family decisions.
